title: Associate, Project Finance
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Associate, Project Finance role supports the financing of Pivot Energy’s projects. This position will manage data rooms and diligence trackers to coordinate deliverables with internal departments. In addition, this individual will support Managers and Directors in financial closings with external stakeholders and financing parties. This position will be a part of a fun and dynamic team while being exposed to capital raise and deal structuring endeavors, developing a deep understanding of renewable project financing.

title: Developer
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Developer, Project Development will be involved in site diligence and project development efforts. The individual will support ongoing site development efforts, assess solar and energy storage sites for critical issues related to project development, and create and secure land lease amendments with landowners for solar and energy storage development. In addition, the Developer will be responsible for creating permitting documents and support and lead project development tasks for assigned projects. The Developer will also manage third-party contractors, prepare and execute land use permits, plan and organize public outreach, and represent Pivot at land use hearings.
There are many moving pieces to develop solar and energy storage projects and take them through financial closing and the ability to prioritize, multi-task, and effectively communicate internally and externally are paramount.
The individual will be provided with the tools and resources for successful delivery of this role, which will lead to growth for both the individual and Pivot Energy.

title: Director, Operational Finance
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
Pivot Energy is seeking a Director of Operational Finance to serve as the strategic bridge between corporate FP&A and operations teams. In this role, you will own the flow of operational data, cost insights, and project financial metrics from development, EPC, construction, and asset management functions into corporate financial planning and reporting. You will establish and maintain financial discipline across project portfolios, drive alignment on cost controls and project economics, and translate complex operational realities into actionable financial insights that support executive decision-making and strategic growth. This is a hands-on strategic position requiring deep operational partnership skills and the ability to influence and align diverse groups without direct authority across multiple functional groups.

title: Director, Project Management
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Director of Project Management leads Pivot Energy’s project management execution across assigned portfolios, regions, customer programs, or enterprise-client workstreams, including greenfield, brownfield, roof top, carport, Mergers & Acquisitions, Tax Credit Transfers, Renewable Energy Credits, and other multi-site programs.
Through disciplined project controls, contract management, team leadership, proactive risk management, and servant-leader principles, this role ensures assigned projects are executed in alignment with Pivot’s standards for cost, schedule, quality, compliance, documentation, and reporting.
The role manages and develops Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, and Coordinators. It also serves as connective tissue between Project Management, Preconstruction, Construction Management, Quality Control, Procurement, FP&A, Accounting, Legal, Development, Asset Management, O&M, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership.
The role is expected to create confidence in the portfolio by ensuring that project data is current, contract obligations are understood, risks are known, formal notices are managed, forecasts are credible, schedules are actively governed, and project teams are operating with discipline.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Denver Colorado, Elkridge/Baltimore Maryland, candidates preferred.  Remote opportunities will be considered.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Pivot Energy, an ESG-focused IPP for distributed renewable energy, is looking for a highly self-motivated individual to manage Pivot Energy’s asset management models. The Manager will focus on improvements to operating model functionality, day-to-day model management, and sensitivity/scenario analyses.
Reporting to the VP of Asset Management. The candidate may be based remotely in the U.S., with periodic travel to our Denver home office and other company locations or for industry conferences, however, preference will be given to candidates based in or around Denver, with the expectation of working from the office on a weekly basis.

title: VP, Talent and Organizational Development
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
Pivot Energy is seeking an experienced People/HR executive to serve as Vice President, People Strategy & Organizational  Development and help build the leadership, talent, and organizational capabilities Pivot needs for its next stage of growth.
This leader will serve as a senior People partner to the business, working closely with executives and managers to  understand where Pivot is going and help build the workforce, leadership capabilities, and culture needed to get there. The  role will develop practical, scalable approaches that help us attract great people, strengthen our leaders, create meaningful  opportunities for growth, recognize and reward performance, and navigate organizational change.
This person will also bring strong People judgment and compliance experience. They will help ensure Pivot handles  employee concerns fairly and consistently, lead or oversee significant workplace investigations, and build frameworks that  allow managers to address performance, development, and workplace issues effectively and appropriately.
Ultimately, we are looking for a leader who understands that taking care of people and building a high-performing business  are not competing objectives. This person should be curious about the business, care deeply about people, exercise  excellent judgment, and be able to turn what Pivot is trying to accomplish into People strategies that strengthen our culture and advance our mission.
